property_summary: For every admissible caller and amount, when CashOut pays out to a reentrant helper, the helper re-entering CashOut once must not be able to withdraw the caller's pre-call balance twice: c.balances(caller) after the first CashOut finishes must be the caller's original balance minus exactly the outer _am (the reentrant inner withdrawal must be rejected because the balance was already decremented by the reference); the mutant subtracts only after the external call, so the inner reentrant CashOut succeeds and leaves the caller's balance too low.
change_summary: Move the balance subtraction to after the external call, changing reentrancy-visible state during the callback.
